summary.text: Karen Dolan is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-22 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She lives in Essex Junction and previously worked as a restorative justice specialist at the Essex Community Justice Center.

paragraphs.text: Karen Dolan lives in Essex Junction, Vermont, and earned a degree from the University of Vermont.
Her career experience includes working as a restorative justice specialist with the Essex Community Justice Center.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she described a twenty-year career in Vermont's nonprofit sector and said she has lived in Essex Junction since 2006.
Dolan's current term began on January 4, 2023, and she advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
She served on the House Judiciary, Corrections and Institutions, and Government Accountability committees in the 2023-2024 session.
In the 2020 survey, she listed COVID-19 recovery, affordable child care, economic opportunity and equitable access to community resources among her policy interests.
